models.name: DistilBERT NER
models.role: The compact baseline: test how much a smaller model can find, and how quickly.
models.domain_limit: Trained on general English news, not bank or insurer reports. It cannot natively label dates, amounts or percentages.

models.name: BERT NER
models.role: The established baseline: compare a larger BERT model with its smaller relative.
models.domain_limit: Also trained on general English news. It shares a family and label set with DistilBERT, so these are not five independent model families.

models.name: GLiNER Medium v2.1
models.role: The flexible-label candidate: tell the model which kinds of names to look for.
models.domain_limit: Custom labels do not guarantee financial expertise. Long company names, acronyms and financial terms still need independent checks.

models.name: NuNER Zero
models.role: The long-name candidate: test whether token-based tagging handles long entity names differently from span-based tagging.
models.domain_limit: Not trained specifically for our reports. Adjacent token predictions need careful merging, and its library version must be checked before a run.

models.name: GLiNER2 Base
models.role: The newer extraction candidate: give the model a structured list of things to identify.
models.domain_limit: It supports tasks beyond names. We must score only the shared name-finding task against the fixed-label models, and keep extra capabilities separate.

annotations.surface: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
annotations.explanation: The formal name of a regulatory organization. Tagging it identifies who is mentioned; it does not interpret the regulatory requirement.
A shorter name for the regulatory organization. A later entity-linking step could connect this alias to the formal name.
The date attached to the announcement. Dates belong to the extended extraction task, not the three-label comparison shared by all five candidates.
An effective date. Finding this date does not establish which requirement it belongs to; that needs separate interpretation.
A percentage mentioned in the passage. Extracting a number is different from checking its meaning or calculating a financial result.
Another percentage. A model must still connect it to the correct measure and time period before it can support analysis.
A named place in the catastrophe-risk discussion. A location tag does not quantify the insurer's exposure there.
